title: Quick head study
content: Painting a head in one minute is a good warm-up exercise. It forces me grasp the essentials right away.Sequence:1. Shadow shapes, 2. Background, 3. Halftones.(Link for video on Facebook)Tools:water brush filled withHiggins Eternal ink, a big flat brush with a diluted ink, and a sable brush filled with water.Timer:an antique one-function electric unit by Cole-Parmer.Reference:photo of Donald Tusk, President of the European Council.
